description: Unit test class for ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter, verifying its behavior in mutability, handling null commands, and modifying acknowledgement request headers in various scenarios.

classes.name: ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for validating the behavior of ThingLiveCommandAckRequestSetter.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the class is immutable using MutabilityDetector assertions.

methods.name: tryToApplyNullCommand
methods.description: Verifies that applying null to the setter throws a NullPointerException with the expected message.

methods.name: removeLiveResponseAckLabelIfNoResponseRequired
methods.description: Checks that the acknowledgement request headers remove the LIVE_RESPONSE label when response is not required.

methods.name: addLiveResponseAckLabelByDefault
methods.description: Verifies that the setter adds the LIVE_RESPONSE label when no acknowledgment headers are present.

methods.name: filterOutOtherBuiltInDittoAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Ensures that only the LIVE_RESPONSE acknowledgment label remains when multiple labels are present.

methods.name: addsLiveResponseAckLabelToAlreadyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Checks that the setter adds the LIVE_RESPONSE label to existing acknowledgment labels when response is already required.

methods.name: notAddingLiveResponseAckLabelToExplicitlyEmptyRequiredAckLabels
methods.description: Verifies that no label is added if acknowledgment requests are explicitly empty, even if response is required.
